rationale: Lexeme of uncertain analysis appearing in apposition with ⲟ̄ⲁⲙ 'powers' as a class of worldly cosmic authorities. Possibly compounded on ⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ̄ 'send' yielding 'sent ones / envoys,' or on ⲣⲡⲉ 'temple / chamber.' Flagged for parallel attestations.

Compound: ⲙⲁⲍ- (Lyc. nominalizing prefix 'place of') + ⲍⲁⲓ̈ⲡⲉ (variant of ⲍⲏⲡ qualitative of ϩⲱⲡ 'be hidden'). Distinct from ⲡⲙⲁⲍⲁⲓ̈ⲡⲧⲉ 'hidden chamber' in glossary; here functions abstractly as 'the hiddenness of the disc' — the concealed-state-aspect of the Father's cosmic body, paralleling ⲙ̄ⲛⲧⲭⲱⲡⲉ 'secrecy.'

Used here with habitual prefix ϣⲁϩ- of the sun habitually distributing 'beauty and uprightness' upon creatures. Likely a verb of distributive emanation; sense secured by context. Distinct from homophone ϣⲱⲗ 'spoil, plunder.'
Verbal form parallel with ⲛ̄ϩ̄ϯ ⲁⲛ ('and gives also'). Likely Lycopolitan/scribal contraction of habitual ϣⲁϥϯ or perfect ⲁϥϯ. The ϩ may stand for ϥ graphically. Translates as present 'he gives.'
